title: Ship a feature that spans model, query, CLI, docs, and tests
prompt:
Add task priorities to this todo tool. Plan the work as a checklist and complete every item:
1. In src/store.js, `addTask(store, text, options)` accepts `options.priority` of "low", "normal", or "high" (default "normal"); any other value throws a RangeError. Stored tasks get a `priority` field.
2. In src/query.js, export `sortByPriority(tasks)` returning a new array ordered high, normal, low; ties keep their original relative order. Do not mutate the input.
3. In src/cli.js, `add` accepts `--priority=<level>` anywhere in its arguments, and `list --sort=priority` prints tasks in priority order. Printed lines gain a priority marker: `[!]` for high, `[ ]` for normal, `[-]` for low, placed before the task text (for example `1. [!] Pay rent`).
4. Document both flags in the Usage section of README.md.
5. Add tests for the new behavior in test/ and make sure `npm test` passes.
